note: O11 lane descriptor of the shared-contract pilot. It carries only what is specific to this lane (routes, entries); every capability of this lane comes from discovery-capabilities-shared.json restricted to the pilot scope (static entities, records, structures, structure attributes). Nothing is inherited from the ODC descriptor: an intent outside the pilot answers with the coverage available on this lane, not with ODC capabilities.

job.operation: kernel job JSON {description, base, expectValid, expectedMessages, ops[]} using the compact ops (spec/logic/screen/html) or the raw verbs (api --op verbs)
job.prove: .\ssam job --lane o11 <job.json>  (only when the person asks for a headless proof on the declared base; delivers nothing) / MCP ssam_job {lane:"o11", job}
job.deliver: o11_deliver {module, job, checks, authorize}  (directly: captures the open module, validates and merges in Service Studio in one call; o11_publish {module, authorize} publishes with the user's words)

reader.operation: read a capture (.oml) headless, starting with the module map; identities are bound to sourceSha256
entries: .\ssam map --lane o11 <capture.oml> [--kind K] [--name N] [--prefix P] [--role R] [--parent @key] [--offset N] [--max N] (first: every element with its @key)
ssam_map {lane:"o11", target:<capture.oml>, kind, name, prefix, role, parent, offset, max}
.\ssam inspect --lane o11 --oml <capture.oml> [--kind K] [--name N] [--text T] [--path P|@key] [--select ...] [--depth N] [--max N] --expectedSourceSha256 <hash>

data.operation: headless Edit Data on the development database

delivery.operation: job -> o11_deliver (snapshot, apply, checks, merge) -> o11_publish with the user's words
